description:
Find genes expressed in a specific tissue and save to CSV file.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table expression_tissues — one record = one tissue's baseline expression of one gene.
Key: id, tissues[].efo_code.
Results: ranked by tissues[].rna.value desc (verified by the harness); one row = one item (one tissue's baseline expression of one gene); `_vbt.total` counts items; `_vbt.grains.gene` counts genes; `_vbt.grains.tissue` counts tissues.
Rows with unknown value are excluded and counted in `_vbt.excluded_unknown`.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Tissues with a measurement for the gene; values of different units are not comparable.
rna values with different units (TPM vs unitless) are not comparable; a value with an empty unit is unknown

schema.description: Pass at least one of: tissue.

min_expression.description: Keeps rows with tissues[].rna.value >= this value; unknown values never pass.
